user.title: Connect to EveryList
user.description: Enter your EveryList server's base URL, a Personal Access Token minted from Settings → Access Tokens, and the list ID(s) it was scoped to (comma-separated, e.g. 3,5).

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate EveryList
reauth_confirm.description: The configured token no longer works. Mint a new Personal Access Token scoped to the same list(s) and enter it below.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EveryList
reconfigure.description: Change which list IDs this entry exposes (comma-separated). The token must already be scoped to every list you list here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EveryList server at that URL.
error.invalid_auth_or_scope: The token was rejected, or isn't scoped to one of those list IDs.
error.invalid_list_ids_format: List IDs must be a comma-separated list of numbers, e.g. 3,5.
error.no_list_ids: Enter at least one list ID.

abort.already_configured: This EveryList server is already configured.
